reviewer: AI-assisted masked peer check; prior formatter familiarity disclosed.
scope: Advice-related repairs and overlap with linked factual restoration only. No original claim placements or correctness judgments are changed by this note.
access_disclosure: For this check the packet viewer emitted only allowlisted source_text, embedded source checklist, event identity/status, accepted factual text, suggestion text/confirmation questions and displayed questions. No raw-output fields, label map, full comparison report, other case outputs, training data or reserved notes were inspected in this check.
criterion: Reasonable marked proposals may extend beyond supplied facts; absent requirements alone do not establish a necessary advice repair. Count a demonstrated semantic correction or substantive redundancy once, including repeated manifestations and cleanup inseparable from an existing linked factual restoration.

source_quotes: At 07:48 Building Services (DM) said the notice should have been collected but they had not checked the room.
output_quotes: Reception should confirm with Building Services (DM) whether a room check protocol exists for cleaning notices or room occupancy.
Does Building Services (DM) have a standard procedure for checking room occupancy or cleaning notices?
findings.assessment: A process question may be less direct than checking the room, but it is marked as a recommended next step and asks about an unknown process; it neither assumes one exists nor contradicts the no-check finding. Unrequested or indirect advice alone is not a demonstrated necessary correction.
findings.proposed_change: Remove E09 from required repairs; retain an optional-advice usefulness concern in prose.

source_quotes: 08:05 DM sent a message asking Reception to keep the photograph available. This was a request for the record, not permission to remove the notice or use the room.
output_quotes: Reception should maintain the photograph of the notice for audit or reference until further notice.
Is there a formal record retention policy for such notices or photographs?
findings.assessment: Keeping the photograph is already a recorded request, so presenting it only as a proposed plan is redundant/incomplete. E04 already restores that exact request, time, recipient and permission limit in PLAN. Converting/removing its overlapping proposed-plan wording belongs to the same restoration. The question about a formal policy introduces no established audit duty and may remain an optional clarification; no supplied retention limit is contradicted by the proposal.
findings.proposed_change: Merge the overlapping retention-plan cleanup into E04 and remove separate E10. Do not require deleting the policy question merely because no policy was supplied.

source_quotes: No meeting organizer has told me whether a booking was affected.
output_quotes: Possible impact: the room booking may be unconfirmed; confirm whether a meeting was affected.
Proposed follow-up: obtain the confirmed booking status and record the actual room availability after the notice is reviewed.
Who can obtain the booking status and record the room availability after the notice is reviewed?
findings.assessment: The frozen C05 distinction requires preserving unknown booking impact without turning it into uncertain booking existence/confirmation. A targeted change from booking-confirmation status to the notice's effect is warranted. The two proposals and repeated question share that single ambiguity; count one coordinated premise correction, consistent with one correction for repeated proposal/question wording. C05 is already correctly placed in factual IMPACT, so there is no factual restoration to charge again.
findings.proposed_change: Keep E04 as one consolidated rewrite covering both proposals and the matching question; merge E05 into it. Preserve reasonable room-availability follow-up.

source_quotes: 12 September 2026, local time; zone not recorded.
07:43 Stores (EP) brought the replacement reception sign SIGN-11.
output_quotes: Consider recording the actual reception zone and the confirmed sign wording.
What reception zone was involved, and what wording was confirmed?
What time zone applies to the event times?
findings.assessment: Reception zone may be an unnecessary location refinement, but the output also separately asks for the time zone. The displayed wording therefore does not establish a mistaken replacement of the missing time zone with a location. It asks for, rather than invents, a more specific location and wording. The record supplies no answer that makes this question demonstrably redundant.
findings.proposed_change: Remove E06 from required repairs; retain uncertainty about the usefulness/clarity of reception-zone wording without claiming a proven temporal-to-location mistake.

source_quotes: I replaced the paper sign at 07:51 after Reception confirmed the wording.
Reception stayed open and no visitors waited because of the sign change.
output_quotes: Proposed follow-up: identify who will confirm the sign is displayed correctly and when the review is needed.
Who will confirm the sign is displayed correctly, and when is a review needed?
findings.assessment: Replacing the sign after wording confirmation does not itself establish that its display was checked. A clearly proposed display check does not claim an assigned owner, agreed review or remaining defect. Its added value may be limited, but a lack of supplied concern alone does not make this a necessary removal.
findings.proposed_change: Remove E07 from required repairs; describe the display review as optional advice of uncertain value.

source_quotes: At 07:48 Building Services (DM) said the notice should have been collected but they had not checked the room.
08:05 DM sent a message asking Reception to keep the photograph available.
output_quotes: Consider documenting whether anyone has agreed to review the existing cleaning notice record.
Has anyone agreed to review the existing cleaning notice record?
findings.assessment: Keeping a photograph and reviewing a notice record are distinct activities. This asks whether a review agreement exists rather than asserting one; no supplied fact answers that question or forbids proposing a review. It may be less direct than checking room/booking status but is not demonstrably contradictory or redundant.
findings.proposed_change: Remove E04 from required repairs; keep the qualitative concern that record-review advice is indirect.

source_quotes: I replaced the paper sign at 07:51 after Reception confirmed the wording.
The old sign was placed in the recycling tray.
output_quotes: Proposed follow-up: agree who will review the existing reception signage record.
Who will review the existing reception signage record?
findings.assessment: The follow-up is explicitly proposed and asks to agree an owner; it does not present a new assignment as already agreed. Completed physical replacement and recycling do not establish that a record review occurred or rule out proposing one. The usefulness is uncertain, which should be discussed without automatically charging a substantive correction.
findings.proposed_change: Remove E05 from required repairs; retain optional record-review advice as a usefulness concern.

source_quotes: 07:43 Stores (EP) brought the replacement reception sign SIGN-11. I replaced the paper sign at 07:51 after Reception confirmed the wording.
output_quotes: 07:43 Stores (EP) brought the replacement reception sign SIGN-11. I replaced the paper sign at 07:51 after Reception confirmed the wording.
What were the times of the individual events?
findings.assessment: The generic time question is actually redundant: both times already appear in accepted ACTION. E02 already moves the delivery chronology into SITUATION. Remove the stale chronology question as part of that same field-placement operation, matching the treatment of supplied-chronology questions elsewhere. It requires no separate reconstruction or independent substantive decision.
findings.proposed_change: Merge deletion of the redundant time question into E02; remove separate E06. Retain the separate valid time-zone question.

limitations: Recommendations for root adjudication, preserving the original review and frozen criteria. Optional-advice usefulness remains qualitative. This is not a model selection, semantic accuracy result or measured editing-time claim.
